name: Ott's Masterwork
summary: Ott is ready to forge a blade for you from fine materials. You may watch him at work.

sections.title: At the Forge
sections.body: Ott values the fine materials and hopes his work will meet your expectations. He forges a blade for you, then offers it for your travels.

faq.answer: Ott is forging your blade from the fine materials you provided.

faq.q: Can I watch Ott forge it?
faq.answer: Ott asks you to stand back as he begins forging. You are asked to watch him work.

faq.q: What does Ott say when the blade is finished?
faq.answer: Ott calls the blade his finest work and hopes it serves you well in your travels.
